text:
maria: heads up — canary p95 for text-gen jumped after merging kernel-routing-optimizer. p95 ~85ms -> ~130ms on canary cohort :rotating_light:
jeff: which commit?
maria: MR 4123 -> commit 9f4b6c2. Deployed to 5% at 1775203000.
taylor: did CI flag this?
ci-bot: CI Perf: perf/kernel-selection-suite FAILED for MR 4123. Regression: p95 +12.3% (92ms -> 103.3ms). https://ci.redwood/infr/perf/4123
maria: staging looked fine due to shorter seq len. Canary has longer seqs and hits the KV hot path more.
priya: can we get raw canary numbers?
maria: quick sampling (text-gen, seq_len ~512):
```
baseline: p50=22ms p95=85ms tokens/s=1450
canary (9f4b6c2): p50=25ms p95=130ms tokens/s=1180
kv-hit: baseline 78% -> canary 74%
kernel mapped: matmul_opt_v1 -> matmul_autodiff_v3
```
jeff: kernel switch + small kv-hit drop. suspect batching heuristic change in same diff altered scheduling.
taylor: agree. batching window tweak could increase context switches for KV cache lifecycle.
priya: can we reproduce locally with canary config?
jeff: bisecting now.
```
$ git bisect start
$ git bisect good 8a2d1f0
$ git bisect bad 9f4b6c2
# result: 9f4b6c2 is first bad commit
```
jeff: 9f4b6c2 touches routing and batching heuristics — culprit.
maria: should we pause the rollout and revert? deploy-bot can pause?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by @maria at 1775203400. Automatic rollback disabled for this deploy (manual required).
priya: I'll open a revert PR and add a perf test to catch this.
taylor: also we need stricter canary guards — current gate checks errors but not p95/tokens/s deltas.
jeff: immediate guardrail proposals:
- abort if p95 increases >10% for 5m on canary cohort
- abort if tokens/s drops >12% for 5m
- require explicit opt-in flag for kernel-choice changes
- add CI perf test with seq_len=512 + kv-cache hot path
maria: also run post-deploy profiler to capture kernel-selection histogram and batching window distro.
priya: opened PR 4137: revert 9f4b6c2 + perf test. CI triggered.
ci-bot: CI: perf/kernel-selection-suite queued for PR 4137.
jeff: if CI passes we merge revert and do controlled A/B: 2% canary for 10m, verify metrics, then scale.
maria: deploy-bot, what happens after revert merges?
deploy-bot: Revert PR 4137 merged. New rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 20% with new perf guard checks.
ci-bot: new job canary-perf-compare emits delta metrics + pass/fail.
taylor: follow-ups: automated rollback script toggled per-release; record reason (metric, window, commit).
jeff: and capture kernel-selection histograms in tracing to detect sudden shifts.
maria: filing retro ticket RH-1672 for release gating and perf alerts.
priya: noted action items:
- revert PR + perf test (priya, 30m)
- canary guardrail spec (jeff, 2h)
- profiler collector for canary job (taylor, 4h)
- ops: enable auto-rollback on p95/tokens/s deltas (maria)

maria: watch eng-runtime alerts for p95/tokens/s. if p95 > +10% sustained 5m, autoscale + rollback to stable.
jeff: agreed. prefer some false positives over letting regressions hit prod.
priya: merging revert now. thanks team :thumbsup:
